child.text:
[{"insert":"Chest Fly + Dumbbell Skullcrushers
 
This is a super set for the chest and triceps. Start with the fly at 30X0, three seconds lowering under control with no pause, opening the arms wide to stretch the chest rather than pressing. Move into the dumbbell skullcrushers on the same tempo, keeping the elbows pointed at the ceiling so the triceps stay loaded through the whole rep. Only thirty seconds of rest sits between them, so pick a weight you can take close to failure on both.
"}]
